title: Constrained multi-cavity with fixed spacers and diversity penalty
scientific_hypothesis: Fixing three central cavity spacer layers at exactly 67.5 nm while applying a thickness diversity penalty will prevent the layer merging observed in route_03, enabling distinct cavity resonances that improve UV passband transmission while maintaining visible/NIR rejection.
design_principle: Multi-cavity bandpass filter with explicitly constrained spacer thicknesses and optimization bounds tightened around quarter-wave values at 267.5 nm center wavelength. Add cost penalty for consecutive layers with >95% thickness similarity.
proposed_topology: 25 finite coating layers: Air | [SiO2/Al2O3]_12 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate. Three central spacer layers (layers 12, 13, 14) fixed at 67.5 nm.
design_variables: optimization bounds tightened to ±15% around quarter-wave targets
soft_objectives: maintain thickness diversity across adjacent layers
manufacturing_considerations: ALD or IAD deposition for thickness precision
quarter-wave layers at 267.5 nm approximately 45-70 nm depending on material index
theory_basis: Transfer Matrix Method for multi-cavity interference
Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectivity mirrors
Cavity resonance theory for bandpass transmission peaks
expected_advantages: Prevents layer merging collapse observed in route_03
Maintains distinct cavity resonances for sharper bandpass edges
Preserves the successful SiO2/Al2O3 material pair from route_03
known_risks: Fixed spacer thickness may limit optimization freedom
Diversity penalty may conflict with optimal physics solution
May still achieve similar target score if merging was not the primary limitation
execution_request_english: Optimize a 25-layer SiO2/Al2O3 multi-cavity bandpass filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layers 1-25 alternate SiO2/Al2O3 starting with SiO2. Fix layers 12, 13, and 14 at exactly 67.5 nm thickness (non-optimizable). Optimize layers 1-11 and 15-25 with bounds ±15% around quarter-wave thickness at 267.5 nm center wavelength (SiO2 ~45 nm, Al2O3 ~67 nm). Apply optimization cost penalty of 0.01 per pair of consecutive layers with thickness similarity >95%. Wavelength bands: maximize transmittance 255-280 nm, minimize transmittance 300-700 nm, minimize transmittance 700-1100 nm. Total layer count exactly 25 finite coating layers. No metal layers. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with diversity constraint. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 255–280 nm; low transmittance in 300–700 nm; low transmittance in 700–1100 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 300–700 nm; transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30; no metal layers; conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Directly addresses route_03 layer merging observation by fixing three central spacers at 67.5 nm and adding thickness diversity penalty per feedback directives. Maintains same material pair and layer count topology.
